class.name: ResonanceAudioMaterialMap
class.brief_description: Maps rendering-material paths to acoustic wall materials for reverb baking.
class.description: Associates each scene [Material] with a [enum ReverbProbeGI.WallMaterial], so a [ReverbProbeGI] bake can look up the acoustic properties of any surface it hits by the material assigned to it in the scene.

method.name: get_material_mapping
method.description: Returns the acoustic material mapped to [param material_path], or [member default_material] if no mapping exists.

method.name: get_material_mappings
method.description: Returns every stored mapping as a [Dictionary] of material path to [enum ReverbProbeGI.WallMaterial].

method.name: has_material_mapping
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if [param material_path] has an explicit mapping.

method.name: remove_material_mapping
method.description: Removes the mapping for [param material_path], falling back to [member default_material] for that material.

method.name: scan_scene
method.description: Walks the [param root] subtree and registers every [Material] found on visible meshes, so each one can be assigned a wall material in the editor.

method.name: set_material_mappings
method.description: Replaces every mapping with the contents of [param mappings].

members.member: Wall material returned for any surface without an explicit mapping.
